newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ to offer 7.9 pct business loan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ to offer 7.9 pct business loan.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Wednesday it would offer a 7.9 percent fixed rate loan aimed at the small business sector and would commit A$1 billion to this sector over the next three months.
ANZ said the three-year fixed rate Business Mortgage Loan would be secured by residential property, with a maximum loan value of A$250,000.

"ANZ has committed a A$1 billion lending facility to support the growth and expansion of small business throughout Australia, by providing cost-effective and competitive lending, along with superiod service," ANZ chief general manager, Australian Retail Division, Peter Hawkins said.

Like the other big four Australia banks, ANZ has come under pressure in recent weeks as the non-bank originator Aussie Home Loans received widespread and favourable publicity for launching a 7.49 percent small business loan.
